description: Agent Recovery: submit a failure-handling flow: who the task is done for and how soon they should hear after a task fails for good, each notice sent then with who it goes to and whether that is the principal, an operator, a team channel or only a log, how soon it goes out and whether it says what failed, what state the work is in and what happens next, plus optionally the tasks that failed for good with when the principal heard and whether from the system, from an operator by hand or by finding out on their own. The signed report says who is told when a task fails for good, how fast and with what detail, and names no notice, notices that reach only operators, channels or logs, and every failure the principal found out about on their own, then every notice past the target, every notice missing what failed, the state of the work or what happens next, and every principal told by hand or late, with the fix for each. This reads the notice to the principal: who owns the response to an incident is wever_incident-ownership-check, an incident response plan’s notification windows are wever_incident-plan-check and where a refused or failed handed-off task goes is wever_handoff-failure-check. Verdict principal_finds_out, notice_gaps, notice_unverified or principal_told. POST /api/failure-notice-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-recovery-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-recovery/.

failures.description: Tasks that failed for good, with when and how the principal heard.

failed_at.description: When the task failed for good.

heard_from.description: How the principal heard: from the system, from an operator by hand, or by finding out on their own.

flow.description: The failure-handling flow, such as booking failures.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

notices.description: Each notice sent when a task fails for good.

name.description: The notice, such as booking failed email.

says_next.description: It says what happens next and what the principal can do.

says_state.description: It says what state the work is in: what finished, what did not, and what was undone.

to_kind.description: Who that is: the principal, an operator, a team channel, or only a log.

within.description: How soon after the task fails for good it goes out, such as 5 minutes.

principal.description: Who the task is done for, such as the traveler.

target.description: How soon the principal should hear after a task fails for good, such as 15 minutes.

name: wever_failure-notice-check
title: Failure notice check
